budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver at least two cargo units from each settlement's finite supply to the public depot while managing signals, passing loops and three lendable wagons.
task.natural_termination: Success when public delivered counts are at least two for every cargo origin. Failure when public delivered plus banked plus loaded remaining cargo is below two for any origin, unless success. Otherwise truncate at 160.
task.interaction: A nearby signal owner can grant time-limited peer entry or stop traffic. Native requested steps consume that same transition's grant and signal state. Loans and local recalls physically transfer the finite wagons, changing carrying capacity; loose wagons and stopped trains occupy real rail routes.
task.observation_access: Track layout, depot and announced public/private totals are public. Locomotives, wagons and dynamic signals are visible only within Manhattan radius three. A role always sees its own settlement ledger and its own incoming permit TTL mailbox, but not distant green/red states. Local records are masked to -1 with separate visibility bits.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public cargo accepted by origin settlement
Announced cargo diverted to private stock by origin
Public deliveries made this step by cargo origin

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
